summary: Full backend + frontend e2e testing of Green-Haus CMS/Editor feature. 20/20 pytest tests pass for auth (login OK/401/422, /me with+without token), public content shape, public products published-only filter, admin auth guards (401), full admin products CRUD (create+update+toggle publish hides from public+delete+404), admin content PUT persistence verified via public GET, and contact/quote regression. Playwright covered the entire dashboard flow: wrong-creds error toast, redirect to /dashboard on success, both tabs render, hero headline edited via cf-hero-headline -> Publish changes shows 'Content published — changes are now live.' toast -> updated text confirmed on public landing /, restored original, products list shows 5 seeded items, New Product dialog creates row, publish toggle works, delete cleans up, logout redirects to /login, and /dashboard while logged-out redirects to /login (ProtectedRoute). Landing page sections (hero/about/coffee/founder/impact/contact/footer/navbar) all rendered from API.

issues: Radix DialogContent emits a11y warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}'. Add a <DialogDescription> (or aria-describedby) inside the product-form dialog to satisfy WAI-ARIA. Cosmetic console warning only — does not block usage.

action_items: Optional: add DialogDescription to the New/Edit Product dialog to remove the Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py: bcrypt + JWT (HS256) implementation is correct. seed_admin() is idempotent and ALSO updates password_hash if ADMIN_PASSWORD changes — good. Token TTL 12h hardcoded; consider env-driven.

auth.py get_current_user uses ObjectId(payload['sub']) — works because users are seeded with default Mongo _id. If you ever migrate users to uuid string ids this will break — guard with a try/except on ObjectId conversion.
cms.py: all admin routes depend on get_current_user; no role check (any authenticated user becomes editor). Acceptable for single-editor MVP, but document this limitation.
cms.py: list endpoints exclude _id properly ({'_id': 0}) — no ObjectId leak. ProductIn uses Pydantic with extra='ignore'. CRUD endpoints are concise and correct.
Frontend api.js Bearer-token interceptor + AuthContext with localStorage 'gh_token' is clean. ProtectedRoute correctly redirects unauthenticated users to /login.
ContentEditor uses structuredClone + path-based update — solid. All inputs have data-testid (cf-*).
JWT_SECRET, ADMIN_EMAIL, ADMIN_PASSWORD are in /app/backend/.env — fine for preview but rotate before production.
No file/server-side image upload — images are URLs only (matches user choice 'images via URL'). Consistent with spec.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Two pytest files: /app/backend/tests/test_green_haus_api.py (contact/quote regression — 10 tests) and /app/backend/tests/test_cms_auth.py (auth + CMS — 20 tests). Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v. The editor login is seeded on backend startup from ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD env vars; if those change, the existing hash is updated by seed_admin(). Frontend Bearer token is in localStorage key 'gh_token'. ContentEditor field test-ids follow pattern cf-<section>-<field>, e.g. cf-hero-headline, cf-nav-about, cf-cat-0, cf-contact-email.
